title: The Fourth, the week before, 2026
logline: The dock a week before the Fourth: no firework this year on the counter; the girl, sixteen, and the boy, thirteen, counting coins into the tin's lid. The page doesn't say what for. The Fourth's page will.

panels.composition: A shop counter with a teenage girl and a boy of thirteen from behind counting coins into the lid of a pushpin tin, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shop counter with a teenage girl and a boy of thirteen seen from behind counting coins into a small tin's lid, a crowded corkboard above, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
